title: 3PL Supply Chain Analysis
short_summary: Shipment pricing and delivery reliability analysis for 3PL optimization
summary: End-to-end supply chain analytics project analyzing shipment pricing, on-time delivery performance, and cost tradeoffs across transportation modes, vendors, and geographies. Identifies SLA risk drivers and highlights where 3PLs can improve reliability without defaulting to high-cost air freight.

datasets.dataset_value: Supply Chain Shipment Pricing Data (Kaggle – Sawandi Kirby)

components.name: Raw Shipment Dataset
components.objective: Collect and preserve raw shipment pricing and delivery records to establish a reproducible analytical foundation.
components.business_value: Ensures traceable data lineage and supports repeatable analysis without reliance on unstable external sources.

components.name: Cleaned Analytical Dataset
components.objective: Standardize shipment fields, dates, and identifiers into analysis-ready structures.
components.business_value: Improves KPI accuracy and reduces analytical noise, enabling reliable performance measurement.

components.name: KPI Calculations
components.objective: Design validated KPI tables for delivery performance, cost efficiency, and vendor reliability.
components.business_value: Provides consistent, reusable metrics that support executive reporting and operational decision-making.

components.name: Tableau Dashboard
components.objective: Build interactive dashboards to analyze SLA risk, cost drivers, and transportation-mode performance.
components.business_value: Enables rapid insight exploration and self-service analysis for operations and leadership teams.

components.name: Executive PDF Presentation
components.objective: Summarize analytical findings, assumptions, and recommendations in a formal executive report.
components.business_value: Supports leadership decision-making by translating analysis into clear, documented insights.

components.name: Executive PowerPoint Presentation
components.objective: Present key insights and recommendations through narrative-driven slide decks.
components.business_value: Demonstrates ability to communicate complex operational findings in stakeholder-ready formats.
